summary: Apetit Oyj manufactures and sells plant-based food products in Finland, Norway, Sweden, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Food Solutions and Oilseed Products. The company offers frozen vegetables, food, and pizzas; vegetable oil; fish based products; rapeseed expeller, BlackGrain rapeseed powder, and rapeseed oil; and burgers, nuggets, gratines, and arctic peas. It also manufactures products for private labels. It serves retail trade, food industry and service, and animal feed industries. Apetit Oyj was founded in 1950 and is based in Säkylä, Finland.
